name: cancel_subscription
description: Customer wants to cancel a telecom subscription or add-on
context_question: I can help you with that. Before proceeding, could you tell me why you want to cancel — is it a service quality issue, pricing concern, or something else?

name: network_issue
description: Customer is experiencing poor network, no signal, or connectivity problems
context_question: I understand how frustrating that must be. Can you describe the issue — is it complete no signal, very slow speed, or intermittent drops? And since when are you facing this?

name: bill_dispute
description: Customer is disputing a charge or amount on their telecom bill
context_question: I'm sorry about that. Can you walk me through what looks wrong on the bill — is it an extra charge, incorrect plan amount, or a service you didn't use?

name: sim_replacement
description: Customer needs a SIM card replacement due to damage or loss
context_question: I can help arrange a SIM replacement. Could you tell me what happened — is the SIM physically damaged, lost, or are you facing a technical issue with it?
